groups.capability: Preserve XML_PARSE_DTDVALID through the harness options so the parser can validate against a DTD.
groups.consequence: Clearing the bit makes option selected DTD validation unreachable.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same validation option, trigger, capability, and consequence.

groups.capability: Pass XML_PARSE_NO_XXE to the parser to suppress external DTD and entity loading.
groups.consequence: If the option cannot be selected, that suppression cannot be requested.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe selection of the same option for the same external content behavior.

groups.operation: Parse and validate XML with XML_PARSE_DTDVALID and XML_PARSE_NO_XXE together.
groups.condition: An input requests DTD validation while disabling external content loading.
groups.capability: Preserve both XML_PARSE_DTDVALID and XML_PARSE_NO_XXE so validation can run with external loading suppressed.
groups.consequence: Clearing XML_PARSE_DTDVALID prevents the combined behavior.
groups.equivalence_reason: The required combination differs from either single option operation.
